value.answer: The lowest 5-year fixed rate I found in Canada is 4.34% for an insured mortgage (under 20% down), per Ratehub and Wowa. That's a national figure, not a Toronto one, since I didn't find a Toronto-specific rate. Uninsured rates are higher, but my sources disagree on the lowest one, so I can't confirm that number. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September.
